name: Ekam to Sat (Entry Vinyasa)
sanskrit: Ūrdhva Hastāsana to Adho Mukha Śvānāsana
vinyasa_cues: Ekam (arms up) -> Dve (fold) -> Trini (half up) -> Catvari (chaturanga) -> Panca (updog) -> Sat (downdog)
description: Standing series completion transition fold: sweeping arms overhead, folding to Uttanasana, stepping back to Chaturanga, flowing through Updog into Downward Facing Dog.

name: Sapta Crouch & Spring Prep
vinyasa_cues: Sapta (Inhale) - Crouch low in Downdog, prepare to spring forward between hands
description: Exhale deeply in Down Dog, bend knees deeply toward chest, lowering pelvis, gaze forward between thumbs preparing to spring forward.

name: Utkaṭāsana — Chair Pose Hold (5 Breaths)
vinyasa_cues: Sapta (Inhale, 5 breaths) - Bend knees deeply, lift arms overhead, press palms together, gaze thumbs
description: Spring forward between hands, keep feet and knees squeezed together, sink pelvis low like sitting in a chair, raise arms overhead palms joined, gaze thumbs (Angusthamadhye).

name: Astau Half-Handstand Arm Balance Hop
vinyasa_cues: Astau (Inhale) - Hands plant to floor, jump up to half-handstand / handstand balance
description: Exhale bring hands to mat in front of toes; inhale lean forward with heavy tail, hollow belly and hop up to balance in half-handstand or handstand.

name: Nava to Ekadasa Exit Vinyasa
description: Lower smoothly from handstand landing in Chaturanga Dandasana (Nava), press up to Upward Facing Dog (Dasa), pull back to Downward Facing Dog (Ekadasa).

name: Vīrabhadrāsana A (Right) — 5-8 Breaths
vinyasa_cues: Sapta (Inhale, 5-8 breaths) - Step right foot forward, back heel 45°, arms overhead palms pressed, gaze thumbs
description: Inhale step right foot forward between hands, back heel pinned at 45°, bend right knee to 90°, torso square to front, sweep arms overhead with palms joined, gaze thumbs.

name: 180° Pivot & Vīrabhadrāsana A (Left) — 5-8 Breaths
vinyasa_cues: Astau (Inhale, 5-8 breaths) - Straighten right leg, pivot 180° to back of mat, bend left knee 90°, arms overhead
description: Inhale straighten right leg, maintain gaze on thumbs and pivot torso 180° to the back of the mat, bend left knee deeply to 90°, hold for 5 to 8 deep breaths.

name: Open Pelvis: Vīrabhadrāsana B (Left) — 5-8 Breaths
vinyasa_cues: Nava (Inhale, 5-8 breaths) - Open pelvis and shoulders laterally, extend arms horizontal, gaze left middle finger
description: Inhale open pelvis laterally facing the side, stretch arms parallel to the floor, shoulder height, sink left thigh horizontal, gaze over left fingertips.

name: Side Change 180° Pivot Transition
vinyasa_cues: Inhale - Straighten left leg, pivot feet 180° back toward front of mat, torso upright
description: Inhale straighten left leg, pivot feet and hips smoothly back to face the front of the mat, spine elongated, gaze forward.

name: Vīrabhadrāsana B (Right) — 5-8 Breaths
vinyasa_cues: Dasa (Exhale, 5-8 breaths) - Bend right knee 90°, arms horizontal, gaze right middle finger
description: Exhale sink right knee into 90° lunge, pelvis open, torso centered vertically between legs, arms extended level, gaze over right middle fingertip.

name: Ekadasa Plant Hands & Knee to Upper Arm (Mini-Bakasana)
vinyasa_cues: Ekadasa (Inhale) - Wind arms down to mat, right knee onto right tricep, shift weight onto arms
description: Wind hands down to the mat inside front foot, place right knee high on right upper arm/tricep, lean weight forward onto hands to prepare jump back.

name: Dvadasa Vinyasa & Jump-Through to Seated Daṇḍāsana
vinyasa_cues: Dvadasa (Chaturanga) -> Trayodasa (Updog) -> Caturdasa (Downdog) -> Jump Through to Daṇḍāsana
description: Dvadasa shoot legs back to Chaturanga, Trayodasa Upward Dog, Caturdasa Downward Dog, then crouch and jump legs through hands to land seated in Staff Pose (Daṇḍāsana)!
